sections.title: KeyEvent
sections.content: Triple witching quarterly OpEx — historically high volume, pin risk around SPX 4400-4450 strikes, mean reversion after gamma unwind. UMich sentiment at 10am ET potential intraday catalyst.

recommendations.thesis: AAPL at all-time highs after WWDC Vision Pro catalyst (June 5). OpEx pin likely around 185 strike with massive open interest. Expect support at 185, continuation push toward 188-189 as gamma unwinds and dealers cover. Breadth leader benefiting from quality rotation. Entry on any morning dip to 185-185.50 level.
recommendations.catalyst: Triple witching gamma release above 185 pin; WWDC momentum continuation; broad market strength
recommendations.riskFactors: Extended run since WWDC, could see profit-taking; OpEx pin could cap upside at 187.50

recommendations.thesis: Financials rotating into leadership post-Fed pause. JPM strongest large bank — retail sales beat supports consumer credit outlook. Trading near 52-week highs with broadening market participation away from pure tech. Rate pause reduces NIM pressure fears while higher-for-longer supports net interest income.
recommendations.catalyst: Fed pause beneficiary; breadth rotation into value; strong retail sales data
recommendations.riskFactors: Hawkish dot plot could weigh if market re-prices more hikes; OpEx volume could create choppy price action

recommendations.thesis: AI momentum leader, just crossed $1T market cap. Parabolic move since May earnings (+$200B in weeks). OpEx creates risk of mean reversion but also potential for gamma squeeze higher if 420-430 calls go ITM. Entry only on morning pullback to 420-423 support zone. Tight stop below 414 (prior consolidation).
recommendations.catalyst: AI narrative dominance; gamma squeeze potential above 425 strike; institutional FOMO
recommendations.riskFactors: Most extended mega-cap — prime candidate for OpEx mean reversion; 1.33 R:R below ideal threshold; parabolic charts vulnerable to sharp pullbacks

recommendations.thesis: Empire State Mfg massive beat (-1.2 vs -15.1 expected) signals industrial recovery. CAT at 52-week highs, breakout from multi-month range. Infrastructure spending tailwind. Breadth expansion trade — rotation from mega-cap tech into cyclicals/industrials. Less OpEx gamma risk than mega-cap tech names.
recommendations.catalyst: Manufacturing data inflection; infrastructure spending cycle; breadth rotation into industrials
recommendations.riskFactors: Philly Fed missed expectations (-13.7 vs -10.4) — mixed manufacturing signals; if risk-off hits, cyclicals sell first

recommendations.thesis: ADBE reported strong earnings June 15 after close — beat on revenue and EPS, raised guidance, Firefly AI product generating excitement. Stock gapping up pre-market June 16. AI beneficiary that's been a laggard vs NVDA/MSFT — catch-up trade. Entry on gap-up consolidation around 485-487.
recommendations.catalyst: Earnings beat and raised guidance; Firefly AI narrative; catch-up to AI cohort
recommendations.riskFactors: Post-earnings gap fills happen; OpEx could amplify volatility on gap-up; need gap to hold

recommendations.thesis: SPX momentum strong, OpEx historically bullish for index when VIX is low and trend is up. Dealer gamma hedging unwind should support index level. 440 massive put OI acts as floor. Entry on any dip toward 441 support. Target 445 (next round number / options wall).
recommendations.catalyst: OpEx gamma unwind supporting index; low VIX environment; Goldilocks macro data
recommendations.riskFactors: UMich sentiment miss could trigger intraday reversal; 4450 SPX is heavy resistance; range-bound regime suggests limited upside
